# fct_site_experiment_assignments

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_site_experiment_assignments` · dbt area: `growth`

Eppo A/B testing experiment assignments that users receive on foratravel.com. Each row is one user-experiment assignment with experiment name, feature flag, and variation. Sourced from Google Analytics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | The user ID of the Advisor associated with that user_pseudo_id >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Portal |
| `advisor_lead_id` | The contact ID of the Advisor Lead associated with that user_pseudo_id >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Hubspot |
| `channel_grouping` | Groups the Attribution fields into a Channel (such as 'Paid Social') using logic defined by Google here https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9756891 >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `device_category` | The device category (mobile, desktop) at the time of assignment >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `device_operating_system` | The device OS (iOS, etc.) at the time of assignment >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `device_web_info_browser` | The device browser (safari, etc.) at the time of assignment >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `email` | The email address provided in the first form submitted for that user_pseudo_id >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `eppo_experiment` | The experiment name in Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `eppo_feature_flag` | The feature flag name in Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `eppo_holdout_key` | The key for a holdout group in Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `eppo_holdout_variation` | The holdout variation (status_quo, all_shipped) for a holdout group in Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `eppo_timestamp` | The timestamp of the assignment from Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `eppo_variation` | The variant name in Eppo >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `event_at` | The timestamp of the event tracked in GA (might not be the same as the eppo timestamp) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_key` | A unique identifier / surrogate key created for the event >> SOURCE - Calculated from GA data data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `geo_country` | The country at the time of the assignment >> SOURCE - Google Analytics / Eppo |
| `new_or_returning_user` | Whether the user was a new or repeat visitor to the site at the time of assignment >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `user_pseudo_id` | The unique identifier of the user as identified by Google Analytics >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
